description:
FOUND s513 (Fable, 2026-10-10) reviewing s513f, which FLAGGED it in its report but did not file it.  Probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p513f/p13-read-place.pl row 3: perl `i=1 b=i`; base `i=1 b=` (#2921: nothing written at all); tree `i=2 b=` (written into $b[1]).  MECHANISM: `%p-with-buffer-place` (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp, the macro p-read / p-sysread / p-recv expand through) does `(let ((cur PLACE)) ... (p-setf PLACE (p-box-value box)))` -- PLACE's forms appear twice in the expansion.  FIX (rule 11, the standard CL shape): evaluate the place's SUBFORMS once -- for a p-helem / p-aelem / deref place bind the container form and the key form to temporaries (the equivalent of get-setf-expansion over PCL's accessor shapes; look for an existing helper that does this for `.=`-into-element (#2115 in-place append) or for `local $h{k}` and reuse it), then read from and write back through the temporaries.  Before this fix the shape was worse (the read landed nowhere); after it the common no-side-effect spelling is right and only a subscript with a side effect is wrong -- that is why s513f was merged with the flag.  Guard rows: `$b[$i++]`, `$h{$k++ . "x"}`, `$r->[f()]` with f counting its calls -- the counter must read 1 and the data land in the first element; inverse-verified.  A filler for the next correctness batch (s513f left #2920 and #2961 too).

=== DONE (s514b) === commit a664c8f3.  %p-with-buffer-place builds read + write-back over a place rebound by the new %p-once-place-form (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp): an ELEMENT place goes through the existing compound-assignment seam %p-elem-place-form (temps + vivifying chain walker); a DEREF accessor (p-aref-deref / p-gethash-deref / p-$ / p-cast-$) binds its non-constant argument forms to temps -- their setf writers are FUNCTIONS, so the answer is identical, evaluated once.  read/sysread/recv share it.  Guard: Pl/t/misc-fixes-03.t rows 6-7 ($b[$i++], $h{$k++ . 'x'}, $r->[f()], ${g()}, an offset read into $hr->{$j++}, sysread, vivifying $h2->{a}{b}; recv over a socketpair) -- perl-oracle, fail on 134ca17f.  SITES THAT CAN ADOPT THE HELPER: the compound-assignment family's DEREF spellings (task #1351: %store-back-form's accessor arm still evaluates `$r->[f()] .= q` twice), and any other read-then-p-setf macro over an accessor place.
subject: SILENT WRONG (new with s513f, #2921): read / sysread / recv into an ELEMENT or DEREF buffer place evaluates the place TWICE (once to read the current value, once to write back), so a side-effecting subscript runs twice -- `read($fh, $b[$i++], 1)` leaves i=2 and writes element 1 (perl: i=1, element 0)
